options.text: Water vapour formed by evaporation, even without big boiling bubbles.
Liquid water again, because evaporation turns vapour into liquid.

stem:
Rupa sprinkles a few drops of water on a hot pan. The drops disappear quickly.

Which claims correctly say what the liquid water has become? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Disappearing liquid water on a hot pan has evaporated into invisible water vapour. Evaporation does not require big boiling bubbles. The vapour is not ordinary air, and evaporation does not turn vapour back into liquid.
